items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Let me just say at the outset they have remained to this day dear friends, they are both wonderful people. I actually did a podcast with Lou recently.

ctx.x: I’d like to talk about that later if we get back to it. But continue — so you go in the booth and Lou is there. Is Carole King there?

Yes. They both were there. Let me just say at the outset they have remained to this day dear friends, they are both wonderful people. I actually did a podcast with Lou recently. I wanted to do one with Carole King but one of her daughters who is her manager, I called her and she said, “Listen, Tom, I don’t think — the answer will be no I can tell you now. She just doesn’t want to dwell on the past anymore.” You know she’s probably done a billion interviews and you know there’s a point at which you go enough…

plus she always lived a rather solitary life. She was in Idaho in a very, very remote part of Idaho. I’m not even sure they had indoor plumbing. It was really, really, you know in the woods kind of lifestyle. And just what a great lady. Lights up a room every time. So anyway, so I listened to the thing, they say play what you feel, I go out and I started playing. And I did a couple of takes but I just, I don’t know we connected. I connected with this tune. And I did maybe two or three takes. They — actually they…
